derived.derived.cession_pct: ceded premiums written (as reported, or gross less net) as a share of gross premiums written
derived.derived.npw_to_surplus: net premiums written to policyholder surplus
derived.derived.roae: net income to the average of opening and closing surplus (the reported return on average equity is series.roae)
derived.derived.reserves_to_npe: net loss and LAE reserves to net premiums earned
derived.derived.reserves_to_surplus: net loss and LAE reserves to surplus
derived.derived.pyd_to_prior_surplus: one-year reserve development as a share of the previous year-end surplus
derived.derived.pyd_to_npe: one-year reserve development as a share of the same year's net premiums earned
derived.derived.accumulated_deficit: surplus less paid-in capital (negative is an accumulated deficit)
derived.derived.recoverable_to_surplus: reinsurance recoverables as a share of surplus
derived.derived.invested_to_liabilities: cash and invested assets to total liabilities
derived.derived.receivable_to_dpw: premiums receivable as a share of direct premiums written
derived.derived.bonds_share: bonds as a share of cash and invested assets
derived.derived.stocks_share: common stocks as a share of cash and invested assets
derived.derived.cash_share: cash and short-term investments as a share of cash and invested assets
derived.derived.dpw_yoy: direct premiums written, change on the previous year
derived.derived.npw_yoy: net premiums written, change on the previous year
derived.derived.surplus_yoy: surplus, change on the previous year
derived.derived.net_capital_flow: capital paid in less dividends paid in the year
derived.derived.combined_avg: simple average of the combined ratios shown
derived.derived.combined_avg_weighted: average of the combined ratios weighted by net premiums earned
derived.derived.years_above_100: years with a combined ratio above 100%
derived.derived.years_below_100: years with a combined ratio of 100% or below
derived.derived.net_income_total: net income added up over the years shown (cumulative)
derived.derived.dpw_growth_pct: compound yearly growth of direct premiums written, first to last year
derived.detail.lines.items.share: a line's share of the year's total (direct premiums, or net premiums earned)
derived.detail.lines.top5Share: the five largest lines' share together
derived.detail.states.items.share: a state's share of the year's total (direct premiums written, or earned)
derived.detail.states.top5Share: the five largest states' share together
derived.detail.recoverables.items.share: a reinsurer's share of all recoverables
derived.detail.recoverables.items.toSurplus: a reinsurer's recoverables as a share of surplus
derived.detail.recoverables.unauthorizedShare: share of recoverables from reinsurers whose tag says they aren't authorized
derived.detail.recoverables.untaggedShare: share of recoverables from reinsurers with no tag
derived.detail.accidentYears.rows.change: an accident year's latest loss and LAE ratio less its first reported one, in percentage points
derived.detail.accidentYears.worst: the largest change of any accident year shown, in percentage points
derived.detail.accidentYears.worse: how many accident years are worse now than first reported
derived.detail.combinedRun: the latest run of years above, or at or below, a 100% combined ratio

cover.subtitle: $122.5M of direct premiums written in 2025, largest line Homeowners

points.text: Direct premiums written of $122.5M in 2025, 13.4% a year since 2021 (derived).
Homeowners is 66.1% of direct premiums; FL is 57.1% (2025, derived).
Combined ratio averaged 97.7% over 5 years (derived), above 100% in 2 of them.
Net income totalled $11.0M over 2021 to 2025 (derived).
Policyholder surplus of $56.3M at the end of 2025; net premiums written were 1.4x surplus (derived).
Net loss and LAE reserves of $57.2M at the end of 2025, 1.0x surplus (derived).
Ceded 38.5% of gross premiums written in 2025 (derived).
Direct premiums written went from $74.2M in 2021 to $122.5M in 2025, 13.4% a year (derived). Assumed premiums written of $6.9M in 2025.
Net premiums written of $79.6M in 2025, after ceding $49.8M.
Homeowners: $81.0M of direct premiums in 2025, 66.1% of the total (derived). The loss and LAE ratio on homeowners was 60.0% in 2025.
FL: 57.1% of direct premiums in 2025; the top three states 81.1% (derived). The direct loss ratio in FL was 56.1% in 2025.
Combined ratio averaged 97.7% over 5 years (derived), above 100% in 2 of them.
In 2025: loss ratio 50.2%, loss and LAE ratio 60.7%, expense ratio 30.8%, combined ratio 91.5%; commission ratio 14.9%.
Weighted by net premiums earned, the combined ratio averaged 97.1% (derived).
The combined ratio was at or below 100% in each of the last 2 years, 2024 to 2025 (derived).
Net underwriting gain of $6.4M in 2025.
Net investment income of $5.6M in 2025, a yield of 3.5% on invested assets; net realized capital gains of $0.6M.
Net income totalled $11.0M over 2021 to 2025 (derived). Return on average equity of 15.1% in 2025.
Net cash from operations of $12.9M in 2025.
Cash and invested assets of $169.3M at the end of 2025: bonds 73.0%, common stocks 10.9%, cash and short-term 13.5% (derived).
Total liabilities of $162.5M at the end of 2025; cash and invested assets were 1.0x liabilities (derived).
Total liabilities were 2.9x surplus at the end of 2025 (derived), with unearned premiums of $38.8M.
Premiums receivable of $24.1M at the end of 2025, 19.7% of direct premiums written (derived).
Policyholder surplus of $56.3M at the end of 2025; net premiums written were 1.4x surplus (derived).
Dividends of $3.0M in 2025; surplus notes of $5.0M at the end of the year.
Risk-based capital ratio of 431.0% at the end of 2025; total adjusted capital $56.3M against an authorized control level of $13.1M.
Surplus was above paid-in capital by $6.3M at the end of 2025 (derived).
Net loss and LAE reserves of $57.2M at the end of 2025, 1.0x surplus (derived).
Reserves were 0.8x net premiums earned in 2025 (derived).
Prior-year reserves developed favourably by $1.1M in 2025, (2.3%) of prior year-end surplus (derived). Two-year development was favourable, $0.9M, in 2025.
Accident year 2022's loss and LAE ratio went from 70.1% first reported in 2022 to 77.0% in 2025, up 6.9 percentage points (derived).
Ceded $49.8M in 2025, 38.5% of gross premiums written (derived).
Nonesuch Re: 31.0% of ceded premiums in 2025 (derived).
Reinsurance recoverables were 59.3% of surplus at the end of 2025 (derived).
18.0% of recoverables at the end of 2025 were owed by reinsurers marked as not authorized, and 0.5% by reinsurers with no status given (derived).
